claim_en: THE THREE CITIES: THEN MOSES SET APART THREE CITIES BEYOND THE JORDAN TOWARD THE SUNRISE, FOR THE MANSLAYER WHO SLAYS HIS NEIGHBOR UNAWARES, NOT HAVING HATED HIM IN TIME PAST, TO FLEE TO ONE OF THESE CITIES AND LIVE — BEZER IN THE WILDERNESS IN THE TABLE-LAND FOR THE REUBENITES, RAMOTH IN GILEAD FOR THE GADITES, GOLAN IN BASHAN FOR THE MANASSITES. 'THEN MOSES SET APART' — the act in the third person, 'then' with the imperfect the Song's construction (Exodus 15:1, Numbers 21:17; six Torah seats); the set-apart root twenty-one Torah seats (Genesis 1's four first; the refuge law's 19:2, 7); 'THREE CITIES' 4:41, 19:7, 19:9, Amos 4:8 — Numbers 35:14's 'THE three cities' with the article the law's one seat; the parser [3]; 'toward the sunrise' 4:41 and 4:47 in the Torah; 'to flee there' with Numbers 35:6; the manslayer-token twenty-eight seats, Numbers 35's fourteen; 'UNAWARES' five; 'hated him not in time past' 4:42 and 19:4 — 19:4 reads 'SMITES', 4:42 'SLAYS', the tail 'and flee to one of these cities and live' the ACT's; 'and live' the refuge's and the serpent's word; the parser [1]; Golan four seats (Joshua 20:8 GAULON); 'for the Gadites' and 'for the Manassites' one seat each; ONKELOS 'then' (4:41, 29:19), 'separated' (4:41, 21:17), 'the slayer' four, 'without knowledge' two, 'to the tribe of' supplied thrice. claim_en: THE FRAME: AND THIS IS THE TORAH WHICH MOSES SET BEFORE THE CHILDREN OF ISRAEL — THESE ARE THE TESTIMONIES, THE STATUTES AND THE JUDGMENTS WHICH MOSES SPOKE TO THE CHILDREN OF ISRAEL WHEN THEY CAME OUT OF EGYPT, BEYOND THE JORDAN IN THE VALLEY OPPOSITE BETH-PEOR, IN THE LAND OF SIHON KING OF THE AMORITES WHO DWELT IN HESHBON, WHOM MOSES AND THE CHILDREN OF ISRAEL SMOTE; THEY POSSESSED HIS LAND AND OG'S, THE TWO KINGS OF THE AMORITES, FROM AROER ON THE ARNON TO MOUNT SION WHICH IS HERMON, AND ALL THE ARABAH TO THE SEA OF THE ARABAH UNDER THE SLOPES OF PISGAH. 'And this is the Torah' one seat — THE SIFREI 323:1: 'this' is nothing but Torah (32:29's 'this' defined from 4:44); 'which Moses set before' one (the verb-with-'before' the offerings' elsewhere); 'these are the testimonies' one — the triad 4:45 and 6:20, the testimonies-word three Torah seats; 'WHICH MOSES SPOKE' 1:1 and 4:45 — THE TWO FRAMES; 'when they came out of Egypt' doubled (45, 46), the fortieth year dated by the exodus; 'in the valley opposite Beth-peor' 3:29 and 4:46 (34:6's grave); 'SIHON KING OF THE AMORITES WHO DWELT IN HESHBON' 1:4 and 4:46 VERBATIM; 'Moses and the children of Israel' the Song's subject pair; 'and they possessed his land' with Numbers 21:35; 'the two kings of the Amorites' 3:8, 4:47, Joshua 24:12, the parser [2]; 'FROM AROER ON THE BANK OF THE VALLEY OF ARNON' 2:36 and 4:48 VERBATIM; 'MOUNT SION' the name's one seat — the mountain's fourth name (the Sifrei 37:9, credited); 'the sea of the Arabah' five, 3:17's 'the Salt Sea' dropped; 'the slopes of Pisgah' 3:17 and 4:49; ONKELOS 'set in order' (one seat), 'testimonies' three, Matnan eight, 'bank' three, 'the sea of the plain' and 'the outpouring of the height' with 3:17.
